package: P0-R9 output / abstention metric correction (private plan 2026-11-20 section 5)
question: Under the existing source-OOF temperature + 2% empirical source-error policy, on how many known external cells does the corrected-normalization model output an answer (fine / parent), and how often is an output wrong?
exposure_status: GSE151530 HCC (25 donors) is a repeatedly used DEVELOPMENT DIAGNOSTIC (scored in phase2-v2 E00, R9 A4 v1, R9 v2 C1). Not blind, not an independent external validation of any policy.
new_training: none. No model, checkpoint, transform, temperature, threshold, prior or label map is refit or changed. Re-aggregation of stored predictions only.
condition_note: sparse_<X> is the name of the SOURCE training condition (target X sparse in training). Coverage/error are over all 5 known external classes, not the target class only.

versions.corrected: PRIMARY: current model = v2 head + v2 calibration (T2-pass tasks: v1 source OOF; T2-fail tasks: v2 source OOF) + corrected external normalization
versions.replay: same heads/calibration as corrected, v1 (HVG-only) external normalization; kept for completeness
versions.original: stored v1 predictions + v1 calibration; kept for completeness

calibration_policy: identical to scripts/r9/v2/c1_a4_eval.py (temperature grid exp(linspace(log .25, log 8, 61)) on source OOF NLL; tau_fine = lowest confidence with cumulative source OOF fine error <= 0.02; tau_parent likewise on non-fine cells at parent level). Not an external 2% guarantee. Recomputed T/tau must equal calibration_provenance.tsv.
output_levels: fine if calibrated max prob >= tau_fine; else parent if max parent prob >= tau_parent; else abstain (unchanged).
known_cells: external cells whose author Type maps to one of B, Endothelial, Fibroblast, Myeloid, T/NK (27,212). Malignant (15,723) and unclassified (7,088) are never put into accuracy; their fine/parent/abstain counts are reported separately.

row_fields.n_fine/n_parent/n_abstain: known cells at each output level
row_fields.n_wrong_fine: fine outputs whose fine label != truth
row_fields.n_wrong_parent: parent outputs whose parent group != truth parent
row_fields.output_error: n_wrong_output / n_output; NA if n_output = 0 (never 0 by default)
row_fields.output_status: no_known_cells if n_known = 0; no_output if n_known > 0 and n_output = 0; has_output otherwise
row_fields.auprc: auprc_<class> (>=10 positives), allmapped_auprc, target_auprc, primary recomputed with the v2 code for the unchanged check only

aggregation.coverage_donor_macro: per donor mean over the 3 seeds, then equal weight over the fixed 25 external donors (donors with n_known > 0; expected 25)
aggregation.error_donor_macro: per donor mean over seeds with n_output > 0, then equal weight over donors with >= 1 such seed; report n_valid_donors and n_valid_donor_seed_rows (out of 25 / 75)
aggregation.pooled_output_error_aux: sum n_wrong_output / sum n_output over all donor x seed rows of (version, condition, model). Auxiliary column; never mixed with donor-macro values
aggregation.ci: donor bootstrap 10,000 resamples (numpy default_rng seed 0), 95% percentile interval, over the donors entering that donor-macro mean. Donors are the unit; cells and seeds are not independent replicates
aggregation.full_donor_table: coverage_per_donor.tsv always lists all 25 donors for every version x condition x model, including no-output donors

primary_report: Descriptive, no between-arm contrast: for LR_donor / corrected, per condition: donor-macro fine coverage, output coverage, abstain fraction and conditional output error with 95% donor-bootstrap CIs and valid donor/seed counts. Other heads and versions are auxiliary rows.

decision_mapping_plan_5_4.applies_to: LR_donor, corrected, each condition separately (the 4 conditions are not pooled)
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.rule_A_few_outputs: donor-macro output_coverage point estimate < 0.50 -> plan 5.4 row 1 (majority of known cells unanswered: not adoptable for full automatic classification; limited high-confidence auxiliary use only as a separate later review). 0.50 restates the plan's 'most cells' wording (plan 0 item 2); it is NOT a minimum-coverage pass line and output_coverage >= 0.50 approves nothing.
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.rule_B_high_error: donor-macro output_error 95% CI lower bound > 0.02 (the policy's own nominal source rate) -> plan 5.4 row 2 (policy practicality insufficient; no threshold re-selection on external results).
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.rule_C_some_ok: output_coverage >= 0.50 AND output_error 95% CI upper bound <= 0.02 -> plan 5.4 row 3 (describe that condition only; no generalization to other rare types; still a development diagnostic).
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.otherwise: error relative to 0.02 not established (CI contains 0.02) -> recorded as undetermined for row 2/3; row 1 still applied by rule A
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.no_output_rows: if any donor x seed row is no_output, it is listed in no_output_summary.tsv and stated next to the decision
decision_mapping_plan_5_4.note: Rules A and B can both apply. No new minimum coverage or maximum error pass line is created; operational requirements are a later user decision to be fixed before the next independent evaluation (plan 5.4).

checks.C1_partition: n_fine + n_parent + n_abstain == n_known on every row; fine_coverage + parent_fraction + abstain_fraction == 1 (|diff| <= 1e-12) on rows with n_known > 0
checks.C2_count_identities: n_output == n_fine + n_parent; n_wrong_output == n_wrong_fine + n_wrong_parent; n_wrong_x <= n_x
checks.C3_totals: per (version, condition, seed, model): sum n_known = 27212, sum n_malignant = 15723, sum n_unclassified = 7088, total 50023; 2100 rows per version, 0 duplicate keys
checks.C4_na: output_error NA iff n_output = 0; fine_error NA iff n_fine = 0; parent_error NA iff n_parent = 0; coverages NA iff n_known = 0; no NA replaced by 0
checks.C5_auprc_unchanged: recomputed auprc_<class>, allmapped_auprc, target_auprc, primary vs stored v2 per-donor-seed tables (all 3 versions): identical NA pattern and max |diff| <= 1e-5 (stored values are %.6g); model-level primary vs a4_model_table_all_versions.tsv; if any differs -> stop and isolate the cause (out of aggregation scope)
checks.C6_fractions_vs_stored: fine_coverage / parent_level_frac / abstain_frac vs stored v2 tables max |diff| <= 1e-5; stored output_error equals new output_error on has_output rows; on no_output rows stored output_error is expected to be 0 (the bug) and is counted
checks.C7_calibration: recomputed T, tau_fine, tau_parent equal calibration_provenance.tsv (|diff| <= 1e-5)
checks.C8_regeneration: summary tables are regenerated by a separate step that reads only output_counts_per_donor_seed*.tsv

nondeterminism: No replay needed: all predictions are stored. The plan 5.5 one-case replay is not run unless a check fails and reconstruction is required.
